chunks: He said: "What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?" He said: "I am better than him. You created me from fire, and him from clay."
ai.seo_question: Why did Iblis refuse to prostrate to Adam according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this dialogue highlights Iblis's intellectual arrogance, where he prioritizes his elemental origin (fire) over the divine command, mistaking material composition for spiritual superiority. This event serves as a foundational case study for the concept of *'Istikbar* (arrogance) and the fall of the angels, illustrating how pride leads to deviation from obedience. The contrast between fire (volatile, proud) and clay (humble, receptive) is often cited to explain the differing natures of Iblis and humanity.
